name: Keisha Lance Bottoms
summary:
Keisha Lance Bottoms (née  Lance; born January 18, 1970) is an American attorney and politician who is the governor-elect of Georgia. A member of the Democratic Party, she served from 2018 to 2022 as the 60th mayor of Atlanta and from 2010 to 2018 as a member of the Atlanta City Council, representing part of Southwest Atlanta.
Bottoms was elected mayor in 2017 and did not seek reelection in 2021.
